            for y in adj[x]:

                    color[y] = 3 - color[x]  # 1->2, 2->1
                    q.append(y)
                    comp_vertices.append(y)

        # count existing edges within component

        for u, v in edges:

        # Wait: this counts all cross-side existing edges across all components in each iteration.
        # Recompute per component properly

        comp_set = set(comp_vertices)
        for u, v in edges:
            if u in comp_set and v in comp_set:

                    existing_cross_comp += 1
